privacy.title: Privacy notice
privacy.intro: This notice explains the information used by ChemWiz for individual and school-managed accounts.
sections: Who is responsible

The operator and privacy contact are shown below. For school-directed class records, the school normally decides the educational purposes and ChemWiz provides the service on its documented instructions. ChemWiz separately decides the purposes of its own account security, support and business administration. Ask the privacy contact if you are unsure who handles your request.
Information and purposes

We use account names, email addresses, password hashes, roles, account and subscription status, learning progress, quiz summaries, settings, mistakes notebooks, usage counters and timestamps to operate the service. Optional AI questions include the selected topic and recent supplied conversation context. Voice features transmit audio when you choose to use them. Guardian and school approval records are used to verify authority and access. Privacy requests and administration actions are recorded to handle requests and demonstrate decisions.
Choices and legal grounds

For adult accounts, necessary account and learning processing provides the service you request; security and required records support its lawful operation. Child processing relies on verified parent/legal guardian authorisation. School-directed processing follows the approved school arrangements. Optional AI, voice and sharing use the separate permissions described here. We record the version of the terms you accept and the privacy notice you acknowledge. Optional AI, voice and school sharing have separate choices. Under-18 learner activation needs a verified guardian authorisation. You can withdraw choices and ask about any remaining records or legal retention needs.
Recipients and transfers

The app host and database provider process the service’s data. EmailJS and its connected email provider process security emails. OpenAI processes Wiz text/audio when the feature is used. Cloudflare may process traffic where configured. Choosing WhatsApp help opens an external service. The operator’s actual hosting, overseas transfer arrangements and provider retention details are shown below. We do not sell learner records or use them for targeted advertising.
Access and retention

Authorised platform administrators can administer accounts and review approvals. School staff access is limited by school membership, learner sharing and assigned classes. Password hashes and reset credentials are excluded from school reports. Active learning records are retained to provide the account; closure and other retention requests are reviewed individually. Approved deletion stops account access first and eligible records are erased after a review window. Backups expire under the operator’s stated schedule. Pending guardian invitations expire after seven days; expiry alone does not erase all approval evidence.
Your requests

Use Privacy and account choices to export account and learning data, change optional choices, or submit access, correction, deletion, withdrawal or complaint requests. Requests may need proportionate identity/guardian checks and assessment of lawful retention. School-managed requests are coordinated with the school. Contact the privacy contact below or POTRAZ if you wish to raise a data protection complaint. You retain your applicable rights when a school pays for your account.

learners.title: Your information, explained simply
learners.intro: ChemWiz helps you learn chemistry. Your information deserves care.
sections: What we save
We save your account details and your learning progress so you can return to your work. Your mistakes notebook and settings belong to your account.
Who can see it

Platform administrators manage the service. When you accept a school membership, authorised school staff can see the class progress described in your school notice. Teachers are limited to their assigned classes. Your password and reset codes are not part of school reports.
Using Wiz safely

Wiz is an AI tutor and can make mistakes. If you choose AI, your question and selected chemistry context go to the AI provider. Voice also sends audio when you choose it. Do not share passwords, addresses, identity documents or private information in a question. Follow your teacher’s laboratory safety instructions.
Parents and help

If you are under 18, your parent or legal guardian must complete the approval process. You can ask your parent, school or the privacy contact for help with your information. Support will never ask for your password or reset code. Use the privacy request form to report a concern.

terms.title: Terms of use
terms.intro: These terms cover use of ChemWiz. School subscriptions also have their signed agreement and data processing schedule.
sections: Accounts and authority

Give accurate account and age information and keep your sign-in details private. Direct adult learners accept these terms for themselves. Learners aged 13–17 need verified parent/legal guardian authorisation before activation; the adult’s written agreement must cover the child’s use. Accounts for learners under 13 are not supported in this release. School payment or a teacher’s approval alone is not proof of legal guardianship.
Learning and content

Use ChemWiz for lawful learning. Do not share accounts, bypass access controls, copy restricted materials for resale, upload harmful or unlawful material, or access another account or school. The operator permits personal educational use of available learning materials while access is valid; other rights and third-party materials remain subject to their applicable licences.
AI and academic work

Wiz provides learning assistance, not guaranteed correct answers or a replacement for a qualified teacher. Check equations, sources and calculations. Never follow hazardous practical instructions from AI. Follow your school’s assessment and academic integrity rules. Significant school decisions must receive appropriate human review.
Plans and payments

Free and paid features depend on your stated plan or school order. Before payment, the seller must give you the applicable price, currency, features, duration, renewal and cancellation/refund conditions. School seat access may end when the subscription or membership ends. Contact support about billing or access disputes. These terms do not remove mandatory consumer rights.
Account changes and complaints

Access may be restricted for security, misuse, account status or missing required approval. Contact support to ask for review. Closing an account is separate from stopping a paid plan; request both where needed. Data handling is explained in the privacy notice. Applicable law is Zimbabwe law, subject to mandatory protections. Contact the operator before payment if you need the commercial terms for your plan or school.

child-safety.title: Child safety and guardian approval
child-safety.intro: Children’s wellbeing and privacy guide the under-18 account process.
sections: Before a child account

A parent or legal guardian contacts the operator to arrange written authorisation. An authorised administrator checks parental/guardian authority through the approved private procedure and records a verification reference. Only then is a limited, seven-day enrolment invitation issued for the approved child email. Send the invitation privately. Do not post it in a class group.
Understanding the choices

The adult and learner should understand what is collected, who can see it, and whether AI, audio and a named school are included. A learner’s assent helps understanding but does not replace required guardian authorisation. Guardian identity documents must not be sent through tutor chat or the ordinary privacy request form.
Changing an approval

A guardian can contact the privacy team to withdraw or change an authorisation after their authority is checked. Withdrawal stops the affected child access and optional processing. At adulthood, the learner must confirm their own account choices. A verified child account cannot simply change its age group before the recorded adult review date.
Safety and AI

Child AI remains unavailable until the operator records its required child safety/provider assessment approval, and the guardian and learner have permitted the feature. Chemistry notes and tools remain available to approved learners without AI. There is no promise of continuous human monitoring. Report concerns promptly and involve a trusted adult where appropriate.

device-storage.title: Cookies and device storage
device-storage.intro: This release uses browser storage to keep sessions and learning state working.
sections: Required storage

The browser stores account tokens and account-scoped learning caches, including pending changes, settings and saved learning information. This helps the app restore your work and handle connection failures. This release does not add advertising or optional analytics cookies.
Shared school computers

Use your own browser profile where possible. Sign out when finished. Signing out ends that browser’s saved sign-in but does not mean every cached learning record or server record has been erased. After saving and exporting anything you need, use your browser’s site-data controls to clear ChemWiz data on a shared device. Clearing unsaved data can lose pending work.
External services

Your email provider, WhatsApp, host or other service may have its own storage and privacy practices. Consult the actual provider information in the privacy notice. If optional tracking is added later, its notice and choices must be reviewed before use.

ai.title: AI and voice choices
ai.intro: Wiz is optional AI learning assistance. You can use approved non-AI chemistry content without enabling it.
sections: What is sent

Text questions, the selected topic/feature and recent supplied conversation context are sent to OpenAI for Wiz. Optional voice notes send audio for transcription. Live voice transmits audio and connection/session information. Browser read-aloud uses your device/browser’s speech service and is separate from live Wiz voice.
Separate permission

AI and voice each have account choices; turning off AI also turns off voice. Browser microphone permission is an additional device permission, not a substitute for the account choice or guardian authorisation. Under-18 access also needs the operator’s provider/safety review and the guardian’s permission.
Retention and limits

The application’s text request disables response storage where supported, but that alone does not establish zero retention across the provider’s systems. Review the operator’s actual provider settings below. Never include private or identifying information in prompts. AI can be inaccurate, and no AI output should decide a child’s rights or educational outcome without appropriate human intervention.
Concerns

Use the privacy request form to report inappropriate content or information handling. Give a brief description without passwords or identity documents. Where immediate help is needed, contact a trusted adult or appropriate local emergency services rather than waiting for an app response.

schools.title: School subscriptions and data handling
schools.intro: School access is provisioned under an approved order, subscription agreement and data processing agreement.
sections: Agreement pack

The school and operator should settle the legal entities, authorised signatories, seats, features, fees, subscription dates, support, cancellation and exit arrangements in a signed order/agreement. The data processing schedule covers instructions, learner categories, access, providers, overseas processing, incidents, requests, retention, exports and deletion/return.
Access boundaries

Platform administrators create schools and assign memberships. Each staff or learner member confirms the membership before school sharing is active. Under-18 sharing additionally needs guardian authorisation for that named school. School administrators see their authorised school roster; teachers see learners in their assigned classes. School staff do not receive platform administration access.
Records and exit

The school receives limited learning progress reports, not password/reset records, guardian verification documents or the mistakes notebook. Staff departure, revoked membership, paused/ended subscriptions and expired subscriptions remove school report access. Account closure and school record retention require the agreed review/exit procedure. Records are not transferred automatically when a learner moves schools.
Responsibilities

The school must provide its notices and authorisation evidence, assign appropriate staff and cooperate with requests. The operator must maintain its own safeguards and act on documented school instructions where it is the processor. Learners keep their applicable data rights. Contact the school and the operator’s privacy contact to resolve questions about school-directed records.
